findings.current: The footage was barely three hours long.
findings.defect: “Barely three hours” suggests less than three hours; 남짓 means a little more.
findings.rationale: The source specifies a duration just over three hours.
findings.replacement: The footage ran a little over three hours.

findings.current: As its name implied, it was a vast organization made up of Hunters from all over the world.
findings.defect: “Hunters from all over the world” omits that every Hunter belongs to the Federation.
findings.rationale: 모든 헌터 makes membership universal, not merely international.
findings.replacement: As its name implied, it was a vast organization to which every Hunter in the world belonged.
findings.source: 그 명칭처럼 전 세계의 모든 헌터가 소속된 거대 단체.

findings.defect: The parenthetical 情意 denotes feeling or goodwill, not justice.
findings.rationale: Justice would be 正義; the supplied characters explicitly distinguish the intended meaning.

findings.current: They had given their lives for God and followed the prophet He had sent.
findings.defect: “Had given their lives” says the followers died, though they are alive in the cave.
findings.rationale: The passage recalls their past devotion and allegiance, not their deaths.
findings.replacement: They had devoted their lives to God and followed the prophet He had sent.
findings.source: 신을 위해 목숨을 바치고, 그분께서 내리신 예언자를 따라 걸었던 지난날들을.

findings.current:
> I’ve decided. I’m naming my unborn child Sibal. It’s a great name, taken from Jin Taekyung’s nickname.
>
> └ A Korean passing by here with some advice: that’s not a very good choice.
findings.defect: The exchange preserves the name but leaves the Korean commenter’s warning unintelligible to readers who do not know the near-homophone.
findings.rationale: The warning depends on how Sibal sounds in Korean; a brief note preserves the joke without explaining it in the speaker’s dialogue.
findings.replacement:
> I’ve decided. I’m naming my unborn child Sibal.[^1] It’s a great name, taken from Jin Taekyung’s nickname.
>
> └ A Korean passing by here with some advice: that’s not a very good choice.

[^1]: “Sibal” sounds like *ssibal*, a common Korean profanity roughly equivalent to “fuck.”
findings.source:
결심했어. 곧 태어날 내 아이의 이름을 Sibal이라고 지을 거야. 진태경의 별명을 딴 아주 훌륭한 이름이지.

└ 지나가던 한국인으로서 충고하자면, 그건 썩 좋은 선택이 아니야.

summary: Several source details are altered, including the footage’s duration, the Federation’s membership, and whether the followers have died for their faith.
